name: walk_newspaper
text: A person walks slowly forward reading a wide open newspaper held in both hands. Both bent elbows keep the hands shoulder-width apart in front of the lower chest, looking down toward the newspaper, with small steady steps.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 双手分开约54厘米持展开报纸，慢步前进；手臂稳定，不做左右摆臂。头部只是轻微低头，后续报纸上沿需置于胸前。
